title: Cloudflare or Akamai: CDN and DDoS Protection From Small Sites to Global Enterprises
excerpt: Two major edge networks compared on how easy they are to start with, how big their global networks are and how well they hold up against very large attacks.
verdict: Cloudflare is an excellent, quick-to-deploy choice for most websites, from small blogs to large businesses, with a useful free tier. Akamai is aimed at very large enterprises that want top-tier protection, global performance and managed services, with an enterprise budget and contract to match.
